questions.stem: Why is alpha radiation considered the most dangerous type if a radioactive source is ingested or inhaled?

options.text: Because it is the most penetrating
Because it is the most strongly ionising, causing the most damage to nearby cells

questions.explanation: Alpha radiation is the most strongly ionising, meaning it causes the most damage per unit distance as it knocks electrons from atoms in living cells. When inside the body, all this ionising energy is deposited in a very small area of tissue, causing concentrated damage to DNA and cells.

questions.stem: What does the ALARA principle stand for?
questions.explanation: ALARA stands for 'As Low As Reasonably Achievable'. It means that radiation exposure should be kept as low as practicable, taking into account economic and social factors. It is the guiding principle behind all radiation safety practices.
